recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of four men in mid-1980s rock attire, posed on dark grey geometric blocks against a textured, mottled blue-grey studio backdrop. The lighting is soft and directional, emphasizing the textures of leather and denim.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a red shirt pop against dark leather
Tiered seating arrangement creating a triangular group composition
Contrast between the cool-toned background and warm skin tones
Repetition of dark leather textures across all subjects
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused studio lighting with gentle shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a tight cluster; one central seated figure, two flanking slightly behind, and one standing/perched to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's red shirt provides the primary focal point amidst a palette of dark blues and blacks.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down to the central figure, then circulates through the surrounding band members' faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant headroom above the subjects and open space to the left for typographic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and navy (clothing and pedestals)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background allows the high-contrast black leather and the single saturated red accent to pop.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool-toned neutrals with one warm primary accent

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in negative space of background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, extended display face and a light, tracked-out secondary face.

preserve: Extended width of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, mid-century modern aesthetic of the main title.
Provides the necessary geometric squareness and horizontal stretch.
Suitable for the clean, spaced-out secondary text at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of four men in their 40s with 1980s feathered hair, wearing black leather jackets and jeans. One man in the center wears a red shirt. They are posed on dark grey cubic blocks against a mottled blue and grey textured wall. Soft studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top left using a bold, extra-extended geometric sans-serif in white. Add a secondary title in the bottom right using a light, widely-spaced sans-serif in white.

verificationChecks: Is the main title font significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the central figure's red shirt the only major pop of color?
Are the subjects posed on geometric blocks?
Is the background a mottled, painterly texture?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the accent shirt
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact wording of the album title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lighting creates soft highlights on the leather jackets.
Check that the typography does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the background texture looks like a physical studio backdrop.
Confirm the color palette remains dominated by cool tones and black.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1980s Rock Portrait = (Mottled Backdrop + Geometric Pedestals) * (Leather Jackets + Feathered Hair) + (Extended Geometric Typography + Red Accent Color)
